new_records.summary_en: A primary NEN record documents an above-threshold Czech Ministry of Defence procurement for engineer wheeled loaders including accessories and supplementary material. The procedure was published on 27 Feb 2025 and, when checked on 20 Aug 2026, the public page is labelled 'Zadán' (awarded). The available public page does not safely establish quantity, model, supplier, delivery or actual unit fielding.
